connector.name: Convalytics
connector.registryDescription: Read-only analytics for Convex apps, queryable via MCP from Claude, Cursor, and other clients.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.convalytics.dev over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the dan-cleary account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Convalytics API token. Create at https://convalytics.dev/tokens. Paste as 'Bearer cnv_...'.
